Due to the popularity of Black Uhuru from the Caribbean, they had to change their name again.  When asked what Sankomota means, Frank Leepa is on record saying that it is the name of a mighty warrior from Basotho and Bapedi people.  Sankomota was the first band to record an LP in Lesotho.  They were recorded by Lloyd Roass and Warrick Sony of Shifty Records in November 11, 1983.  The album was self-titled; Sankomota and it has 9-tracks and it is under 50 minutes long.
